notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 28% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the fifth-lowest in the league (a typical team: 41%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Thomas Chabot is out 1-2 weeks (upper body injury) and missed their last game. He is a top-pair defenseman. Tyler Kleven has taken his spot beside Jordan Spence.
William Eklund is out 10-12 weeks and has missed the last 6 games.
Jake Sanderson returned in their last game after missing 8 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Artem Zub was added to the roster on Oct 16 and has played beside Thomas Chabot.
Jordan Spence has started killing penalties: on the ice for 35% of the team’s shorthanded time in 10 games, up from 4% last season.

stakes: The Sharks go in fourth in the Pacific with 11 points, the Senators tied for second in the Atlantic with 14 points.

OTT.head: The matchup suits the Senators
OTT.body: Even though Ottawa is on the second night of a back-to-back, the Senators have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. The Sharks can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.
